subject: London exec roundtable — onsite contingency & on-call plan
content:
From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme-corp.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: London roundtable logistics — safety items

Hi Vivek / Laura —

We're finalizing travel for the June 12 exec roundtable in London. Two quick asks from Acme security and our legal/comms team:

- Can you share the on-site contingency plan for medical incidents and severe weather?
- Who is the 24/7 on-call contact from Redwood while our execs are traveling?

We have a handful of attendees with dietary restrictions and one attendee with a mobility impairment; would appreciate any accessibility notes too.

Also copying our travel vendor (Tom Hartman) to align on local ambulance/clinic contacts.

Thanks,
Sarah
Senior Program Manager, Acme Corp

---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 12:38:00 +0000
Subject: London exec roundtable — onsite contingency & on-call plan

Sarah —

Thanks for the heads-up. Attached is a concise contingency brief tailored for executive travel: oncall-rotation-sheet.xlsx and local-resources-london.pdf. Key points below (TL;DR):

1) On-call coverage
- Primary on-call: Vivek Kulkarni (mobile +44 7700 900111) — escalation to Laura Bennett (VP Ops) after 30 minutes if unresolved.
- Secondary: Marissa Cole (on-site logistics lead) for vendor coordination.
- We will publish a small physical card for each exec with the 24/7 line and local emergency numbers.

2) Medical incidents
- Minor illness: vendor-affiliated clinic (listed in local-resources PDF) — transport available within 20–30 minutes via vendor.
- Serious incident: call 999; then notify Redwood on-call immediately. We will coordinate hospital intake and ensure an internal point-of-contact escorts the family/next-of-kin message.
- For medication/allergy events: keep a named list with attendee consent. Please confirm any prescription meds and emergency medications (e.g., EpiPens).

3) Weather & transport disruptions
- Alternate meeting rooms reserved at the hotel and a backup virtual bridge is provisioned (dial-in info in the PDF).
- If flights are canceled, Acme travel vendor (Tom) will prioritize rebooking; Redwood will provide two options for remote presentation if an exec cannot attend.

4) Accessibility & mobility
- We requested ground-floor meeting rooms and stair-free routes; vendor confirmed wheelchair-accessible shuttles for point-to-point.

5) Insurance & documentation
- All Redwood travelers will carry copies of travel insurance and a company emergency card.
- If Acme needs a POI or escalation matrix for your legal/comms teams, I can attach a two-page contact matrix.

Action items:
- Sarah: confirm attendee special medical needs and consent to share abbreviated medication list (needed by Jun 6).
- Tom: confirm ambulance/paramedic partner details and transit buffer assumptions.
- Marissa: finalize on-call rotation and include hotel front desk in distribution.

Attachments: oncall-rotation-sheet.xlsx (rotations, phone numbers), local-resources-london.pdf (clinic, embassy, taxi, accessible routes).

Cheers,
Vivek
Director, Global Operations
Redwood Inference

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 08:15:00 +0000
Subject: Re: London exec roundtable — onsite contingency & on-call plan

Vivek / team —

This looks solid. Two additions from leadership:

- Escalation cadence: 0–30 min: on-call triage; 30–90 min: VP Ops (Laura) + legal notified; 90+ min: Exec sponsor (I'll notify CPO if incident affects meeting outcomes).
- Contingency budget: pre-authorize up to £5k for immediate on-site expenses (taxis, expedited travel, interpreter/medical translation) — work with finance to record spend and get retro approval.

Vivek — please prepare a 5‑minute run-through for the execs during the pre-travel briefing on Jun 10 (covering what to do if separated from the group, medical authorization forms, and the 24/7 number). Marissa, coordinate the two-minute table card for each exec.

Laura
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference
